changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.objects where object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[FeatureFlag]') and type in (N'U')) begin create table dbo.FeatureFlag ( Id smallint not null, Slug varchar(100) not null, TrueLabel varchar(25) null, FalseLabel varchar(25) null, [Description] varchar(500) null, IsPermanent bit not null, DefaultValue bit not null, constraint PK_FeatureFlag primary key clustered (Id asc) ) end
